paragraphs: Rav Natan bar Mar Ukva said in the name of Rav Yehuda, [Berakhot 13b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.13b.16).[^1]

notes.text: Both the Bavli and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2749&lang=en) give Rav Natan bar Mar Ukva as the transmitter and Rav Yehuda as the authority he cites.
